decisions.reason: The chair family is close to the core offer and shares its production base, so holding it costs little and it adds to the established seating range even though recent market evidence is missing.

Carpet floor cushions are a niche accessory whose value has had four years to show and is not visibly confirmed, but they reuse rug materials at low holding cost, so the option stays open only narrowly.

The high standing table fits the office and conference range, where flexible workplace demand after 2020 may lift its value, and its low incremental cost justifies keeping it while that demand plays out.

The rug collection is the firm's strategic flagship into a new field and supports related lines such as the floor cushions, so management keeps this growth option despite its distance from the core and limited evidence so far.
